checks: Verified original §6, equation (17) and the bounded-multiplier passage. A uniform hinge bound excludes negative threshold divergence at any positive-volume sampled fiber. A fixed kernel residual separates all positively diverging evaluation coordinates simultaneously; bounded replacement retains the exact varying finite coordinates and makes the remaining ones uniformly empty.

Common sufficiently small affine increments preserve equality of nonomitted margins and leave omitted margins below −3/4. The original cover has some nonomitted margin at least zero at every point, still at least −1/4 after the increment. Thus all local cap-mass, hinge and pointwise max functions match, as do the fiber minima and their generalized gradients.

Bounded finite parameters give uniform convergence of pointwise maxima and hence limiting closed coverage. Null limiting cap planes give convergence of masses, moments and hinges. Summing offset balances bounds the contact multipliers by total cap mass plus the bounded budget sum times a fixed section bound.

At positive limiting contact multipliers, compactness of the saddle law spaces and uniform convergence pass both saddle inequalities. Omitted traces have strictly negative margin and hence no weight at zero-value contacts. At vanishing multipliers the terms vanish. A finite convex combination reproduces all limiting saddle moments by compactness and Carathéodory.

Choose rotations/translations carrying each nearby plane to its limit and tending to identity. Weak section limits retain plane-measure domination and actual closed-section support. Proper-section relative interior lies in the body interior, yielding full density by indicator convergence, also at d=1; supporting limits allow density in [0,1]. Pass all three moment equations and complementarity, with objective coefficient fixed at one.
